servers.name: PDF Reader MCP
servers.description: Citra - PDF evidence provider for agents. Provides tools for reading, analyzing, and extracting structured text, tables, OCR, visual evidence, and citations from PDF documents.

tools.name: read_pdf
tools.description: Read and extract text, tables, and structured content from PDF files

tools.name: search_pdf
tools.description: Search for text or patterns within PDF documents

tools.name: analyze_pdf
tools.description: Analyze PDF structure, metadata, and content intelligence

tools.name: extract_tables
tools.description: Extract tables from PDF documents with proper formatting

tools.name: ocr_pdf
tools.description: Perform OCR on PDF pages to extract text from scanned documents

tools.name: get_pdf_metadata
tools.description: Get metadata information about PDF documents

servers.name: PuTTY MCP
servers.description: SSH and terminal session management for remote connections. Provides tools for creating SSH sessions, executing commands, managing PuTTY saved sessions, and file transfers via PSCP/PSFTP.

tools.name: session_open
tools.description: Open a new SSH session or PuTTY saved session

tools.name: session_send
tools.description: Send commands to an active session

tools.name: session_read
tools.description: Read output from an active session

tools.name: plink_exec
tools.description: Execute commands via PLink (PuTTY command-line tool)
